prerequisites: The student has a thorough knowledge of the subject matter discussed in the OS Fundamentals course.

learning_outcomes.text: The student sets up DNS in a Windows Server environment and configures it redundantly, so that DNS lookups of both internal and external names can be performed from a computer in the network, using the recursive DNS lookup concept.
The student sets up an Active Directory environment where multiple Domain Controllers redundantly enable the management of this environment.
The student can use Group Policies to achieve various security measures and/or automation.
The student can integrate an email server into the Active Directory environment, allowing email to be sent and received.
The student sets up Remote Access using a self-configurable VPN.

assessment_rules: If the student scores less than 6/20 on one of the educational activities, the student can achieve a maximum of 9/20 for the total course unit. There are partial transfers for successful partial results (Theory within the academic year, Lab within the academic year). Resit for the theory exam and demonstration of lab assignments in the lab, by appointment.
